_how_to_edit: What the MENU CHARACTER says on the main menu, for each main menu item (scenes/main_menu/main_menu.gd ITEMS).
One block per fighter, named after the fighter's ShortName in lower case (cecilia, flan, leticia, noah).
Each line is shown in the speech box: \n starts the second line. Keep each half to about 40 letters.
Item names: versus, training, arcade, network (ONLINE), customize, gallery, commands (COMMAND LIST), options, return.
A line that is missing (or empty) falls back to Cecilia's line for that item.
"_status" is only a note for whoever writes the lines: "final" or "PLACEHOLDER" (written by Claude, please review).
A new fighter: copy a block, rename it to their ShortName in lower case, rewrite the lines.
Keep the commas and quotes as they are (it's JSON): after editing, the game shows Cecilia's lines if the file can't be read.

cecilia._status: final (the original lines; customize is new: please review)
cecilia.versus:
Looking for a sparring partner?
Pick your fighter - I'll be waiting!
cecilia.training:
The practice hall is open.
Want to run some drills with me?
cecilia.arcade:
One opponent after another...
Sounds like a good test of steel.
cecilia.network:
Challengers from far away?
Bring it on!
cecilia.customize:
A new look for the road?
Let's find one that suits you.
cecilia.gallery:
Memories from our journey...
Let's look through them sometime.
cecilia.commands:
Want to go over the moves together?
Take all the time you need.
cecilia.options:
Adjust the controls and sound
however you like.
cecilia.return:
Heading back already?
I'll be right here.

flan._status: PLACEHOLDER - written by Claude, please review
flan.versus:
A fight? Yes, yes, YES!
Pick someone strong - I'm all fired up!
flan.training:
Warm-ups first! Fists up,
and keep going till you see stars!
flan.arcade:
One after another? Ooh!
I'll punch my way right to the top!
flan.network:
Someone far away wants a fight?
Tell them Flan says hi - with her fists!
flan.customize:
Ooh, dressing up? Make it sparkly!
Stars go with everything.
flan.gallery:
Pictures from the journey!
I'm the one with the peace sign. Always.
flan.commands:
Star Fist, Rising Star, Meteor Drop...
Wanna learn them all? I'll show you!
flan.options:
Fiddling with settings?
Okay, but hurry - my fists are getting cold!
flan.return:
Leaving already? Aww...
Come back soon, okay? Promise!

leticia.training:

leticia.arcade:

leticia.network:

One after another, until no one's left.

noah.network:

I'll be here. I usually am.
